planets.name: K2-285 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-285 with a 3.47-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-285 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-285. Its orbit and size follow Palle et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
